title: Rendered Love
method: htdemucs vocal stem -> torchaudio MMS_FA forced alignment, each line inside its hand-stamped window, checked by a pass with each line's neighbours in a wider window
notes: start/end: aligned onset/offset (line start falls back to hand_start when its words do not agree between the two passes). hand_start: the hand-stamped LRC time. dev = start - hand_start. score/confidence: mean CTC posterior (0..1); sung vowels score low even when placed right. agree: the anchored and the context pass put the word start within 0.35 s; rating comes from the share of agreeing words.

lines.text: The monitor glows, cold and blue
Another frame I push right through
I'm building worlds inside this box
But I can't break through the digital locks
The hours bleed into the night
Reflected in the screen's harsh light
The coffee stains the same old desk
A lonely, self-imposed grotesque
I search the footage, cut by cut
For the perfect face, but the memory's shut
Rendered love, a ghost in the screen
The only place where you have been
I slow the playback, frame by frame
Whispering your impossible name
This fiction is the only proof
Beneath my self-imposed roof
I smooth the light, I fix the hue
Because reality was never true
This digital avatar knows my fears
A silent star of endless tears
I choose the filters, dark and deep
The secrets that my hard drive keeps
I am the director of this pain
Watching my desire loop again
The irony is sharp and clear
The one I need is trapped right here
Inside the codec, beneath the glass
A pixelated lie that will never pass
I coded beauty, I crafted grace
To fill this hollow, empty space
But the texture is cold, the touch unseen
Lost somewhere between two thousand screens
I search the footage, cut by cut
For the perfect face, but the memory's shut
Rendered love, a ghost in the screen
The only place where you have been
I slow the playback, frame by frame
Whispering your impossible name
This fiction is the only proof
Beneath my self-imposed roof
Just artifacts and noise
Just artifacts and noise
Rendered love, fading out
The screen goes dark
